title: Software Development Test Engineering Senior Professional
description:
**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
   

  

**Function:** 
 (DEAI HV) Product
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 R0137531
   

  

**Our Company**
 We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers \- from banks to theme parks \- can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate \- and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team \- and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data.
   

  

**The Team\- Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Development Test Engineering Senior Professional to join our dynamic team at Hitachi, Ltd. This role involves leading and executing complex testing strategies to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products and systems.
   

  

**The Role**
* Design, develop, and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for various software components and systems.
* Lead and mentor junior test engineers, providing technical guidance and fostering best practices in software quality assurance.
* Automate testing processes using various tools and frameworks, including developing and maintaining automated test suites.
* Perform functional, regression, performance, integration, and user acceptance testing across the software development lifecycle.
* Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with product management, development, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing scope.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methodologies, processes, and tools.
* Analyze test results, generate reports, and provide insightful feedback to improve product quality and development efficiency.
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging testing technologies, tools, and industry trends.
* Configure and troubleshoot networking infrastructure, including Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLANs, routing, and network security settings, to support integrated software, hardware, and industrial system testing.


**What You’ll Bring \- Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5\- 9 years of progressive experience in software development test engineering, with a strong focus on automation.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C\#, JavaScript) for test automation development.
* Extensive experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG).
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) and quality assurance principles.
* Experience with various testing types, including functional, non\-functional, API, and UI testing.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps) and test management tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, complex environment.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting network infrastructure, including managed switches, VLANs, TCP/IP networking, routing, and related connectivity technologies in development, test, or production environments.
* Experience with object storage technologies, data lake house architectures, and modern data platforms used to support analytics, machine learning, and AI\-driven solutions.
* Familiarity with AI/ML workflows, data engineering concepts, and validation of data pipelines, models, and AI\-enabled applications.


**About Us**
 We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
   

  

**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

**How We Look After You**
 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

 We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Quality Control Manager
description:
QUALITY CONTROL MANAGER
 



**Industry:** 
 Silica Ramming Mass / Refractory
 



**Location:** 
 Durgapur, West Bengal / Jamshedpur, Jharkhand
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Workplace Type:** 
 On\-site
 



**Experience:** 
 8–10 Years
 



**Relevant Industries:** 
 Refractory, Ceramic, Mineral Processing, Silica/Quartz or Iron \& Steel
 



 Job Responsibilities
 



 • Control and monitor the quality of Silica Ramming Mass from incoming raw materials through to the finished product.
 



 • Inspect and test incoming quartz and silica raw materials for chemical composition, moisture content and relevant physical properties.
 



 • Conduct Particle Size Distribution (PSD), sieve analysis, moisture testing and other relevant refractory quality tests.
 



 • Monitor crushing, screening, grading, blending and mixing processes to ensure adherence to approved specifications.
 



 • Ensure batch\-to\-batch consistency and compliance with established quality standards.
 



 • Maintain quality\-control records, laboratory test reports, Certificates of Analysis (COA) and batch traceability documentation.
 



 • Investigate quality deviations, non\-conformities and customer complaints, and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
 



 • Support customer trials and coordinate with technical and production teams for continuous product and quality improvement.
 



 • Ensure laboratory equipment is properly maintained and calibrated and that testing procedures are followed consistently.
 



 Candidate Profile
 



 • B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Chemistry
 



 • Diploma / Degree in Ceramic Engineering, Refractory Technology, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy or a related technical discipline.
 



 • 8–10 years of relevant experience in the Refractory, Ceramic, Mineral Processing, Silica/Quartz or Iron \& Steel industry.
 



 Preferred Experience
 



 Candidates with hands\-on experience in
 **Silica Ramming Mass / Induction Furnace Refractories** 
 , along with practical knowledge of
 **Particle Size Distribution (PSD), refractory testing, raw\-material inspection and quality\-control processes** 
 , will be preferred.

title: SAP BRIM CI FICA-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Career Family \- SAP Utilities / BRIM**
**The opportunity**
 As part of our EY GDS team, you will work to implement and support SAP FI\-CA/ Convergent Invoicing projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problem.
   

  

 We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in SAP FI\-CA / FI\-CAX and SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management – Convergent Invoicing to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* To provide functional knowledge with hands\-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS\-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non\-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Sound experience in SAP FI\-CA (Contract Accounting)
* Strong SAP FI\-CA, FICA – FI SD and FI MM integration knowledge
* Development experience in S/4 HANA, SAP ECC across all types of RICEFW objects
* Being familiar with SAP CRM/SOM/Hybris would also be very helpful
* Strong knowledge of SAP CI would be very helpful with minimum one end\-end BRIM CI implementation experience integration with SAP BRIM SOM, CC.
* SAP BRIM (CI) Functional Consultant in implementing SAP BRIM (CI) solution to support subscription business models.
* Must have strong knowledge of CI configuration and integration with SOM, CC, SD \& FI\-CA, FI/CO components of SAP solution.
* Additionally, must have extensive experience in implementing SAP FI\-CA, FI/CO solution.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands\-on experience on FI\-CA concepts:
+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month\-end and period\-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on integration with third\-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:
+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240\)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245\)


**Technologies and Tools**
* SAP FI\-CA / FI\-CAX
* SAP BRIM CI
* SAP FIORI
* Jira
* Azure DevOps


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

description:

 Technical Lead \- VIM for SAP
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32591**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Technical Lead in this position will be responsible for all solution components of the Vendor Invoice Management solution. And contribute to configuration, continuous improvements and standardizations of VIM solutions across SAP systems with the objective to optimize exception, approval and blocked invoice workflows and to increase efficiencies and to maximize the level of automation of the full end\-to\-end process.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable.  Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?

* And support the development of automated tests
* Also, gather and analyze business requirements, translate these requirements into functional and technical scope and functional specifications
* Ans also, design, build and implement improvements and new functional solutions for Vendor Invoice Management processes in SAP based on state\-of\-the\-art SAP standard system capabilities and technical standards, complying with Linde IT standards and IT strategy and fully meeting business requirements
* You will also be required to identify opportunities for process improvements, efficiencies and cost reductions, leveraging S/4Hana capabilities and new VIM functionality
* And coordinate the implementation of new VIM functionality in SAP ECC and S/4Hana Systems according to Linde plc project management guidelines
* You must contribute in knowledge transfer/guidance to and training preparation and delivery for IT and business stakeholders of new IT functionalities and IT solutions
* And collaborate and consult with business and IT teams or stakeholders and manage external service providers to deliver highly dependable, secure, and integrated solutions meeting compliance requirements to the business
* Lastly, cross\-skilling team members to allow growth of team members, distribution of knowledge across team members and a more flexible work allocation.

* And Global Certification(s) in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions, S/4 Hana implementation experience required, ITIL Certification preferred
* A must is also 6\+ years of experience in technical design, implementation and support of international large\-scale systems in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (VIM), at a minimum experience in two end\-to\-end large scale VIM implementations.
* Along with Experience in working with onshore as well as offshore teams
* Knowledge on extensive skills in the implementation and optimization of Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (up to most up\-to\-date versions in SAP ECC and S/4Hana) and in the set\-up, administration and optimization of Invoice Capture for SAP
* Must is In\-depth knowledge of SAP and VIM standard functionalities with the aim to minimise programming


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.

It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.

 To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose\-led and values\-driven leader at every level.  across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.

title: Software Tester
description:
We're a small US software company. We build fast with AI\-assisted development, and we need one exceptional manual tester who finds what the automated tests miss. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role. You will be the first dedicated tester on the team, reporting to the founder.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Test new features and fixes before they reach customers: end\-to\-end workflows, edge cases, data imports, payments, permissions, and multi\-tenant isolation.
* Write bug reports a developer can reproduce in one read — steps, expected vs. actual, screenshots or video, severity, and what you think the cause is.
* Build and maintain the test checklist for each product area; keep a regression pass that runs before every release.
* Verify data migrations: source records vs. what the system shows, count by count, field by field.
* Communicate proactively. You'll tell the team what you're testing, what you found, and when you'll be online — before anyone asks.
* Push back. If something ships that you flagged, we want to hear about it.



  





**Must Have** 



* 3\+ years of manual / exploratory testing on a production web application, with references who can describe your work.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will write directly to engineers and occasionally read customer\-reported issues. This is assessed on the call and in your writing sample — please apply only if you're genuinely fluent.
* Experience testing financial software — payments, banking, lending, collections, or billing — where correctness is mandatory.
* Meticulous documentation habits. Show us a bug report you're proud of.
* **Flexibility. There is no set schedule. You'll work around the team's time tables — the founder, the implementation manager, and the engineer are in US time zones — and part of the job is live: reproducing a bug on a call, walking an engineer through what you found, joining a release check before it goes out. Some weeks that means early mornings IST, some weeks late nights. If you need a fixed shift, this isn't the role. What we ask in return is that you communicate — when you're available, when you're not, and what you found — clearly and without being chased.**

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.
